dimensions.mission: Collection continues from one approved profile: children, authority, activation, tails, alerts and operational plan/apply/rollback without per-window manual steps; live enablement stays a separate OPERATE gate.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Profile revisions are immutable rows; children are normal frozen V1 episode schedules equal to the approved template; V1 grants, A, armed B, C1/C2 and all identities are untouched; the schema change is optional keys only.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One task, one new module plus seams in existing owners; 28 focused tests, 47-module/735-test direct-consumer regression, five mutation controls; no pre-PR full gate; exact-head CI is mandatory.
dimensions.research_truth: No estimand, filter, seed, grid or T0 change; one owner per UTC day keeps cohort scopes releasable; HOLD and mid-day windows leave nomination gaps that are UNKNOWN, not negative evidence, and are named for downstream consumers.
dimensions.owner_operability: One phrase per profile, zero per child; plan shows numbers and refusing axes; typed terminals with next_action; runbook table; OPERATE packet with stop/rollback and acceptance; Russian readout with residuals.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Collection operability only; no trading, alpha, revenue or cashflow claim; no provider call.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Durable incidents deduplicated through the existing watch; crash resume from the saved intent; restore marker blocks controller and tick; binary rollback after the first managed child is forbidden (forward fix); policy rollback is a new revision.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: ADOPT existing lifecycle, store, tick, watch, account budget; WRAP with a small controller. No service, queue, cron generator or second collector.
dimensions.security: No credential read, no secret, no external write; derived authority is bounded by the approved template; approval is integrity not provenance (named).
dimensions.red_team: Five mutations (child beyond grant, backdated window, storage never blocks, no event repair, no HOLD) are killed; tamper at derive and tick time, competing reconciler, clock backwards and rollback widening fail closed.

capability_radar.now: Exact merge gate, then one OPERATE: deploy, plan, one profile apply, B handover on 18.10, TEST alert readback. No new tool.
capability_radar.watch: I2 packaging for runway; measured managed adapter above 100/day; external host-loss receiver; per-round gap marker for HOLD/mid-day windows.

recovery: Before the first managed child redeploy the previous artifact (tables additive). After it, forward fix only; policy rollback is collection-rollback; never edit managed or counter rows by SQL.
